name: Prince Diponegoro
lore: Led the Java War (1825-1830), the most costly war the Dutch ever fought in the Indies. A prince who gave up his palace to fight for his people, Diponegoro's guerrilla tactics tied down 23,000 Dutch troops.

abilities.name: Jungle Sovereign
abilities.description: Diponegoro and all allied units gain +20% move speed and +10% damage when in jungle terrain.

abilities.name: Guerrilla Strike
abilities.description: Diponegoro vanishes into jungle for 6 seconds. His next attack deals 3x damage and stuns for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Java War Cry
abilities.description: Summons 6 guerrilla fighters that emerge from jungle tiles within 200 tiles. Each deals 60 damage on spawn to nearest enemy.
